title: Lattice use-case manifest
description: One action a host offers: its contract, and per-host wording. engineering/decisions/2026-11-17-use-case-layer.md §3.

$schema.description: The editor hint to this schema.

id.description: snake_case verb-noun, stable forever; the folder and file are named for it.

default.description: What it does and when to use it, for any host.

chat.description: The Studio chat's wording; it may name the draft and the turn.

describe.description: What it does, when to use it and when not, per host.

tier.description: read changes nothing; draft stages a change for review; act does something a person confirms.

effects.description: What it may change; ["none"] for a read.

destructive.description: May a call remove or overwrite author content?

idempotent.description: Does running it twice change nothing further?

confirm.description: When a person must confirm it.

input.description: The arguments, as JSON Schema (an object). A {{NAME}} placeholder is filled by the host at runtime (tools/build-use-cases.js).

requires.description: Host capabilities it needs before it is offered.

legacy.description: One of the chat tools that predate the manifests, held by SANCTIONED_LEGACY_USE_CASES in tools/check-ownership.js.

position.description: Where the tool sits in the chat's list; the order is the cached prompt prefix.

activity.description: What the transcript says while it runs.

drafting.description: What the transcript says while its arguments arrive.

chat.description: How the Studio chat presents it.
